name: Oysters and Macaroni
author: Fannie Merritt Farmer (1896)

ingredients.item: ¾ cup macaroni broken in 1 inch pieces

steps: Cook macaroni in boiling salted water until soft; drain, and rinse with cold water.

Put a layer in bottom of a buttered pudding-dish, cover with oysters, sprinkle with salt and pepper, dredge with flour, and dot over with one-half of the butter; repeat, and cover with buttered crumbs.
Bake twenty minutes in hot oven.

culture.text: From The Boston Cooking-School Cook Book (1896) by Fannie Merritt Farmer. It popularized level, standardized measurements (cups and spoons) in American home kitchens, and stayed one of the best-selling cookbooks in the United States for decades.
